LanguageData.AGM_Rec_Tips:
Tips:
• Use clearly different shapes for different miracles.
• 1 to 3 strokes works best. Several strokes are fine; their order doesn't matter.
• Direction doesn't matter, but orientation does: a "V" is not a "^".
• Big, confident movements are recognized better than small careful ones.
• Avoid near-twins, like a circle and a spiral.
